# README Tools & Resources

Tools that help generate, enhance, or validate READMEs. Recommend these to users who want to go beyond a static markdown file.

## README Generators & Templates

- [Make a README](https://www.makeareadme.com/) - A guide to writing READMEs. Includes an editable template with live Markdown rendering.
- [readme-md-generator](https://github.com/kefranabg/readme-md-generator#readme) - A CLI that generates beautiful README.md files from project metadata.
- [Readme Forge](https://readme-forge.github.io/) - A component-based README generator with an extensive template library.
- [READMINE](https://github.com/mhucka/readmine#readme) - A thorough, self-describing README file template for software projects; copy and edit as needed.
- [README best practices](https://github.com/jehna/readme-best-practices#readme) - A place to copy-paste your README.md from.
- [Standard Readme](https://github.com/RichardLitt/standard-readme#readme) - A standard README style specification with a generator to help create spec-compliant READMEs.
- [Amazing GitHub Template](https://github.com/dec0dOS/amazing-github-template#readme) - Useful README.md, LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, SECURITY.md, GitHub Issues, Pull Requests and Actions templates.
- [Common Readme](https://github.com/hackergrrl/common-readme#readme) - A common readme style for Node. Includes a guide and a readme generator.
- [Zalando's README Template](https://github.com/zalando/zalando-howto-open-source/blob/master/READMEtemplate.md#readme) - Simple template covering all the basics.
- [StackEdit](https://stackedit.io/) - Online Markdown editor for quickly customizing README sections.

## Dynamic Badges & Stats Cards

Use these to add live-updating elements to READMEs.

- [GitHub Readme Stats](https://github.com/anuraghazra/github-readme-stats#readme) - Dynamically generated customizable GitHub cards (stats, extra pins, top languages, WakaTime).
- [GPRM](https://github.com/VishwaGauravIn/github-profile-readme-maker#readme) - Tool to generate a customized GitHub Profile README with a modern UI.
- [README Typing SVG](https://github.com/DenverCoder1/readme-typing-svg#readme) - Dynamically generated SVG that gives the appearance of typing and deleting text.
- [Github Licenses Stats](https://github.com/lheintzmann1/github-licenses-stats#readme) - Generates a dynamic SVG showing top licenses across your GitHub repos.
- [GitHub PR Stats](https://github.com/f14XuanLv/github-pr-stats#readme) - Dynamic SVG tables for GitHub pull requests with dual modes and customizable fields.
- [user-statistician](https://github.com/cicirello/user-statistician#readme) - GitHub Action that generates SVG of detailed GitHub user activity for profile readmes.
- [Telegram Card](https://github.com/Malith-Rukshan/telegram-card#readme) - Dynamic preview card generator for Telegram channels, groups, and bots.

## Contributors & Community

- [Hall-of-fame](https://github.com/sourcerer-io/hall-of-fame#readme) - Shows recognition to repo contributors. Features new/trending/top contributors. Updates every hour.

## Feedback & Auditing

- [maintainer.io](https://maintainer.io/) - Free README standardization and feedback (click 'Book an audit').

## Creating GIFs for READMEs

Animated GIFs demonstrate what a project does and are the single most effective way to communicate a UI quickly.

| Tool | Platform | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| [Gifski](https://github.com/sindresorhus/Gifski#readme) | macOS | Best color quality at low file size |
| [ScreenToGif](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/) | Windows | Open source, customizable UI |
| [LICEcap](https://www.cockos.com/licecap/) | Windows/macOS | Less intuitive but feature-rich |
| [Giphy Capture](https://giphy.com/apps/giphycapture) | macOS | Easy upload to giphy.com |
| [Peek](https://github.com/phw/peek#readme) | Linux | Simple and easy to use |
| [terminalizer](https://github.com/faressoft/terminalizer) | Cross-platform | Record terminal sessions as animated GIFs |
| [ttystudio](https://github.com/chjj/ttystudio#readme) | Cross-platform | Terminal-to-GIF recorder for CLI tools |
| [vhs](https://github.com/charmbracelet/vhs) | Cross-platform | Generate terminal GIFs with a scripting language |

**Tip:** For CLI tools, prefer `terminalizer` or `vhs` (scriptable, reproducible). For GUI/web apps, prefer `ScreenToGif` or `Gifski`.
